method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. Two candidates in this window returned HTTP 404 on the live API (uid 108f2edcfb6b67d8 FR Agent magasinier / Agente magasiniere gestionnaire de stocks, uid 112d65cfb3e268bf DE Lagermitarbeiter / Kommissionierer m/w/d) and were held, joining the still-held postings 00cfb0e9af186fce, 0c10c84afe31213a and 0dad6f50ad84127b. No candidate in this window carried the legacy partial-AR marker, so no overwrite:true fills were needed.
